title: True (VIS) Lies: Analyzing How Generative AI Recognizes Intentionality, Rhetoric, and Misleadingness in Visualization Lies

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification metrics (precision, recall, and Matthews Correlation Coefficient) on a balanced dataset to identify models' statistical tendency to indiscriminately label visualizations as misleading regardless of the ground truth.

Assessing the ability of models to infer authorial intent by prompting them to detect 'Bias Exploitation' (whether a visualization was deliberately crafted to take advantage of known human visual, perceptual, or cognitive biases) and rating its contribution to the misleading effect.
